# Networks.ipv6 property

The IPv6 networks, as a [NetworkList](/api/net/latest/net.networklist/) — reachable as `.ipv6`<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
readonly [NetworkType.IPV6]: NetworkList;
```

## Remarks

Unset when the set has no IPv6 networks, exactly as with [Networks.ipv4](/api/net/latest/net.networks.ipv4/)<!-- -->. Its buffer goes back in through the constructor's `networks6` argument.
